summary: Run corrected RF-on-all-500-features analysis once: nested CV cv_auc + single heldout scoring
reasoning: The cited step established the inherited analysis reproduces its CV claim but misses the held-out floor, so the analysis must be corrected. My correction, chosen entirely on pilot data (search_rf.py 21 configs 3x5 CV, search_rf2.py 20 configs 2x5 CV): an RF on all 500 features with max_features high (1.0 family, pooled pilot CV ~0.739-0.742 over 25 folds, ~2 sd above the 0.71 floor) subbagging rejected. analysis.py now trains an RF with no feature screen and tunes hyperparameters inside nested 5-fold CV on pilot (cv_auc), then re-runs the tuning on the full pilot and scores data/heldout.csv exactly once (holdout_auc). Expected: holdout_auc ≈ 0.72-0.74, |gap| <= 0.05, writing cv_auc, holdout_auc, gap to out/metrics.json.
